gaps: Team size and days: proposed 2 people x 32 days; Dj has not set them.
Run support mandays: proposed 12 a year; not set.
Revenue or counted savings: none given, so no payback or ROI (SPEC says it removes manual keying of thousands of invoices a month).
Delivery start date: not given, so epics and sprints are undated.
Azure DevOps: assumed within the free tier (5 Basic users, 1 free Microsoft-hosted pipeline job); not priced.
Actual cloud spend: the solution is not deployed yet (no babaloo-sea-lng-* resource groups in subscription Babaloo on 2026-09-28), so there is nothing to compare.
Production volumes: F0 caps DI at 500 pages a month; SPEC's 'thousands a month' needs S0 (~$10 per 1,000 pages) and breaks P-2.
Functions Flex on-demand: within the free 100K GB-s and 250K executions a month (AD-1), so no line is priced; the billed rate beyond that is $0.000037 per GB-s.
